world.description: Cs protects Sn (FA-rich lattices); Cl passivates Sn-Pb

goal: Find a stable, lead-reduced perovskite absorber for single-junction solar cells: bandgap 1.24–1.38 eV with T80 ≥ 500 h.

slots.purpose: Test H5: Cs/FA double-cation Pb iodides are the stable baseline.
Test H1: Bandgap mixes linearly (Vegard's law), so half-Sn iodides sit midway between end members.
Test H2: Sn-Pb mixing bows the bandgap below both end members.
Test H6: MA-majority films are thermally unstable.
Test H3: Any film with ≥30% Sn degrades fast from Sn(II) oxidation.

decision.rationale: No data yet, so slots test the goal-relevant literature hypotheses (H5, H1, H2, H6, H3); H4 parked because their regions cannot meet the spec.

hypotheses.statement: Bandgap mixes linearly (Vegard's law), so half-Sn iodides sit midway between end members.
hypotheses.prediction: bandgap (eV) between 1.40 eV and 1.56 eV for Sn 0.4–0.6, Br = 0, Cl = 0
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region fall outside 1.40 eV–1.56 eV.
hypotheses.rationale: Default assumption for alloy bandgaps.

hypotheses.statement: Sn-Pb mixing bows the bandgap below both end members.
hypotheses.prediction: bandgap (eV) < 1.36 eV for Sn 0.3–0.7, Br = 0, FA ≥ 0.6
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 1.36 eV.
hypotheses.rationale: Reported anomalous bowing in mixed Sn-Pb iodides.

hypotheses.statement: Any film with ≥30% Sn degrades fast from Sn(II) oxidation.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 400 h.
hypotheses.rationale: Sn2+ oxidation is the dominant failure mode of Sn perovskites.
critiques: Too broad: region covers 73% of the space; a pass/fail says little about mechanism.
Conflicts with supported H8 on 96 shared compositions.
Conflicts with supported H12 on 40 shared compositions.

hypotheses.statement: Br-rich mixed halides without Cs segregate and lose stability.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 250 h.
hypotheses.rationale: Light-induced halide segregation.

hypotheses.statement: Cs/FA double-cation Pb iodides are the stable baseline.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure <= 600 h.
hypotheses.rationale: Entropic stabilisation of the black phase.

hypotheses.statement: MA-majority films are thermally unstable.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 250 h.
hypotheses.rationale: MA volatilises under heat.

hypotheses.statement: Sn content near 0.4 lowers the bandgap beyond the linear-mixing expectation.

hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 1.40 eV.
hypotheses.rationale: Cs0.1FA0.9Pb0.6Sn0.4I3 measured Eg 1.29 eV vs prior Eg 1.48 eV (z = -2.3); ridge attribution points to Sn (weight 0.04).

hypotheses.statement: Cs content near 0.1 raises stability in Sn 0.2–0.6 films beyond literature expectation.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure <= 89 h.
hypotheses.rationale: Cs0.1FA0.9Pb0.6Sn0.4I3 measured T80 159 h vs prior T80 157 h (z = -2.0); ridge attribution points to Cs (weight 0.10).

hypotheses.statement: In Sn 0.2–0.6 films, adding Cs (≥0.05) raises T80 by more than 2×.

hypotheses.kill_condition: False if, after ≥2 films per arm, the difference is below a third of the predicted effect.
hypotheses.rationale: Contrast test isolates the driver from Sn content.
